name: Lexington Feet Fest 2019

venue.name: Follen Church
venue.details: Please enter through the side entrance on the building.

information: **3x3x3 With Feet is the main event of this competition!** 3x3 With Feet will be the only event held at this competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or looking for more normal events, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other local competitions.
